question: Does the apparent accuracy improvement persist once StandardScaler is fit strictly on training rows and duplicate sample IDs across splits are removed?
target_scope: Tabular binary classification benchmark (30-sample diagnostic split)
construct_or_estimand: Held-out accuracy difference between leaky and clean preprocessing pipelines
measurement: Held-out test accuracy on disjoint sample_ids
rival_explanation: The accuracy gain is an artifact of pre-split scaling and duplicate sample IDs across splits
expected_if_focal: Accuracy gain remains after fixing scaling and split IDs
expected_if_rival: Accuracy gain disappears once scaling is fit inside train split and splits are disjoint
discriminating_test: Compare leaky_pipeline.py vs clean_pipeline.py on clean disjoint splits
falsifying_result: Accuracy collapses to baseline once leakage is fixed
indeterminate_result: Split integrity check fails to establish disjointness
engineering_diagnosis: Pending resolution of detected preprocessing and split-integrity failures
